title: Dent style formatter options

comment_style.description: Marker for single-line comments. Omitted keeps each comment as written; block comments are never rewritten.

end_of_line.description: Line ending style. Omitted means auto-detect from the input.

indent_size.description: Spaces per indent level. Ignored when `use_tabs` is true.

trim_empty_lines.description: Collapse consecutive blank lines and strip leading/trailing blanks.

use_tabs.description: Indent with tabs rather than spaces.

print_width.description: Maximum line width before wrapping with `\` continuations. 0 disables wrapping.

single_quote.description: Prefer single quotes over double quotes.

description: Formatter options for a conformance case.
